annotations.title: Set the tool permissions of an integration

description:
Set the tool permissions of an integration

Stores which tools the agents of the account may use through this integration, exactly as the dashboard does. Choose a preset (`read`, `read_write`, `full`) or `custom` with the exact tool keys from `tools[].key` of the GET of this path. Only the permissions change; the rest of the stored configuration stays as it is. Every agent and chatbot the integration is assigned to then gets its tool list rebuilt, so the change takes effect in their next conversation: `agentsResynced` counts the agents that were updated, `agentsFailed` the ones that could not be updated now (the saved permissions still apply to them). A tool selection of an agent (`enabledTools`) that names a tool outside the new permissions is not changed, but the tool stays unavailable to the agent. An unusable choice is refused with 422 and error code `validation_error`. Integration types without tool permissions answer 404.

body.description: The new choice: a preset, or `custom` with the exact tool keys agents may use.

preset.description: `read` allows the reading tools, `read_write` adds the writing tools, `full` allows every tool, `custom` allows exactly the tools listed in `tools`.

tools.description: The tool keys agents may use, as listed under `tools[].key` by GET /integrations/{id}/permissions. Required and non-empty for `custom`, ignored otherwise.

id.description: Identifier of the integration. A non-numeric value is rejected with 400.
